decisions.reason: The product page was present in 2019 and the absence in later years is likely due to website archiving gaps rather than discontinuation, so no strong signal to drop.
Similarly, B was promoted in 2019 and the missing archives do not provide evidence of underperformance, so management would keep it.
C also had its own page in 2019, and since the whole website was not archived later, there is no indication it should be dropped.
